lines.speaker: finch_pilot
lines.text: Contact, bearing zero-one-zero, inside the rock wall. It's... not on any registry.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: It's glowing. Why is it glowing? Ships don't glow.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: That's no beacon code. It's a pattern. Fives. It's counting at us.

lines.speaker: wren_pilot
lines.text: Wren and Kite, sliding out to the flanks. Nanda, you hold the middle.

lines.speaker: finch_pilot
lines.text: Holding the middle. Not panicking. Logging everything.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: All ships, weapons free, but keep your distance. Nobody gets cute.
